svg.title: IDEA Server Module authority
svg.desc: Scoped administrators call only their owning Modules. Identity and Accounts supplies actor eligibility, Project Governance supplies memberships, and Access Policy returns permission decisions. Controlled Product Data, Product Structure and Lifecycle Governance retain their own business authority and append committed outcomes to Audit Evidence.
